### D-004 — Owner directs this session to fix its independently measured portal findings
Date: 2026-10-11
Avi's latest instruction extends the previously approved direct route A from testing to implementing the issues that pass exposes. This session retains its thirteen finding work-items WI-10008222/23/24/25/26/27/28/29/30/34/35/36/41 and repairs them under the existing Execute and repair phase, preserving current R-4 durable repair/recurrence/verification requirements and source/runtime evidence distinctions.
